_comment: Companies confirmed to run public Greenhouse/Lever job boards, grouped loosely by field. Used as a fallback default in ingest.py when GREENHOUSE_BOARDS/LEVER_BOARDS env vars are empty, and as a starting point you can copy from into your .env. Board tokens can go stale if a company migrates ATS providers - verify by visiting boards.greenhouse.io/<token> or jobs.lever.co/<token> before relying on one. GET /admin/board-health checks these live; the scheduler now also checks them periodically and alerts on newly-stale tokens (see app/core/board_validator.py) - if a token below goes stale again, prefer letting that alert catch it over silently leaving a dead token in this file.
